decisions.decision: Single canonical boot: bootstrap-capsule → start-sci-os with transactional stages
decisions.reason: Conflicting boot authorities caused truth drift and false READY
decisions.allowedEvolution: Add stages/observability; do not fork second orchestrator

decisions.reason: Stabilize product URLs; retire 5200/5230 as canonical
alternativesRejected: Random port per install without contract

decisions.decision: 200+ professions via Role Registry + Experience Compiler composition
decisions.allowedEvolution: More role data/config; new shared primitives
acceptanceCriteria: No new role ships as a separate app

decisions.decision: Consequential actions use Action contract + risk/governance + idempotency
decisions.reason: Prevent unsafe retries and policy bypass
acceptanceCriteria: Same-process retry does not duplicate side effect

decisions.decision: Shell (cockpit-ui) IS AppHost for first release
decisions.reason: Avoid second host framework before boot/Home proven

acceptanceCriteria: Home reachable; professional default not raw JSON
